pedido.description: Top-down map of a forest training ground for a 16-bit SNES JRPG, tall portrait format. A pale dirt footpath enters at the bottom center and winds upward in a wide zigzag to the top, passing five round wooden plank platforms spaced evenly along it; the last platform at the top is bigger, with green banners. Lush green grass, flowers, bushes, mossy rocks, and big leafy trees crowding the left and right edges. Bright cheerful colors, clean detailed pixel art, no text, no letters, no characters, no interface.
